description: Remove one of your hooks, the same as deleting it by hand on autoview.com: its exchange links, then the hook itself (alerts sent to its URL stop placing orders), then any saved exchange API keys no other hook still uses (real-money keys included; keys another hook links are kept). The token must be scoped for every exchange the hook links, and a hook linking a real-money exchange needs a live-scoped token, the same as connect. One transaction, all or nothing. A hook that is already gone, or is not on your account, is reported as ok with already_gone:true and nothing is deleted. Needs the token's "Allow revoke and unlink" permission, which is off until your user ticks it at /account/tokens/. Requires your Autoview account token.

hook_id.description: the hook to remove: one of your hooks (see the `hooks` tool)

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).

name: unlink
